notes.title: REAVER Demo Major Update 2023
notes.notes:
Hello! It's been a year since the demo release and we've been working this whole time on Early Access version of the game, and prior to that we want to update demo version. 
Join Discord server and tell us what you think about the game!
  What's new:

 Clockwork level (the last one) was changed heavily.
 Actual weapon progression added. Find weapons through map and be able to manage your inventory in Arms Shops on every level.
 Big Scourge doesn't clip through surfaces anymore.
 Player doesn't randomly clip through surfaces anymore.
 Enemy's health and weapon damage got reworked heavily.
 Player movement is now more precise and faster.
 Grenade of blue machine gun can now be shot with Red Revolver's ultimate.
 Changed Turbo mode time multiplier from 1.33 to 1.25.
 Added Turbo audio mode to increase pitch of music and sounds.
 Added skybox to Purgatory level.


We highly recommend revisit demo again as it much smoother in terms of performance and much more balanced gameplay-wise!

As always, looking forward to listen to your feedback (preferably in Discord server or direct message me crunkzah#2323)

Best regads,
REAVER Team

notes.title: 0.7.1 DEMO Update: Custom Music!
notes.notes:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049665/253b842c6b82fc3086f0b921e67ec3da0560d479.png
Ever wanted to have the reactive environment sync to meme music? Well now ya can!
(Just not very user-friendly, for now. Needs to be set up through console.)

Welcome to the 3rd update of the REAVER Demo!
You made cute art, and badass music, but lets go over the update first.

REAVER UPDATE
FIXES

 Fixed critical error where collision would stop working, for real this time.
You should clip through the floor less now.
 Hook has been improved!
Should be less janky. Hook stuck bug should occur less now.
 Fixed a teleport bug in machinery.
Where falling off would send you to the wrong place.
 Lighting in City broke from moving to new Unity version.
Its nice and moody again.

BALANCE

 Pulling out your second machinegun no longer overwrites the dagger on that hand.
Using an ability shouldn't deny your consumable.
 Hitboxes are made slightly larger.
We noticed if you didn't go for headshots, body and limb shots are harder to hit than they should be. Nothing should feel different if you primarily aim for headshots.

QUALITY OF LIFE

 More keys are now viable for rebinding.
No one's gonna stop your wacky setups.
 Console toggle key can now be rebinded.
If you think about it, with a WASD setup, ~ is pretty close to your left hand.
 New option to toggle main hand model. (the one that holds 1st gun)
Floating guns look cool.
 New option to mute game when window is unfocused.
If you alt-tab often.



Custom Music!

Experimental feature. Setup via console commands, for now.
[olist]
custom_music ███  ....................where "███" is your wav/mp3 audio file path.
music_pitch #  ....................affects pitch of your custom music
funky_scale #  ....................how hard you want funky mode to go
cursed_mod #  ....................value can be either 1 or 0, scales saturation with music pitch.
[/olist]
 You can cycle through all of music anytime!
Again, sorry about the not user friendly options lol
[olist]
Cycle music track  hold leftAlt + left/right arrows
Change music pitch  hold leftAlt +up/down arrows
[/olist]
 New FUNKY game modifier to compliment your custom music!
Its best you discover what his does yourself, unless you have epilepsy.


Community Highlights!
These baddass + chill remixes are loop-able, and perfect as custom music, try it!
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049665/376f85d3eb7d83cc0a35c8ae43b106666a5ee5b5.png
REAVER REMIXES by still crisp
These are really freakn cool, follow still crisp's soundcloud!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049665/3df39abed9c387bfb0a4465a13dab3fa3b40c0c0.jpg
Smol Water Statue Lady by Kuma
Cute n Sassy!

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42049665/00bc97161d2b6cd3415243bd1a712e901f49bcd9.png
Cute Sinclair Sketch by Hallacas
Nice and funky art style


Aaand that's about it for the update, see ya in the discord, and remember:
We aren't entitled to your cool fan creations, but we appreciate them so much!
JOIN US IN DISCORD

Search & Contribute to the Wiki!
Watch & Submit official speedruns!

notes.title: DEMO Update 2: Community, QoL, Fixes & Balances
notes.notes:
Hope ya didn't just drop the game after a single playthrough!
(This is a joke, we fully expect you to drop the game after a single playthrough.)

Welcome to the second update of the REAVER Demo!

We got lots of changes! REAVER is still growing, and we're so darn happy you're still playing the game and discovering new ways to [strike]break[/strike] play our game! The videos, the clips, the art, the fact that there's always something to check out on our discord server, we are incredibly grateful to have such an active, supportive community of movement-shooter junkies. Thank you, sincerely.

Mushy stuff aside, BEHOLD: REAVER FAN ART

Thank you Kuma for the art, and the permission to use it!

TAS run by wao destroyer
We have TAS runs now, impressive!
[previewyoutube=R8e5CwzTVtM;full][/previewyoutube]


REAVER UPDATE
FIXES

 Fixed critical error where collision would stop working
No more getting sent to the backrooms!
 Revolver fire rate fixed
The Revolver fire rate was bugged last patch while we were experimenting with dual-wielding revolvers... oops.


BALANCE

 DeepSix difficulty no longer randomizes enemies
We recognize RNG isn't everyone's thing, enjoy being 2-shot though!
 Nerfed Copter (the flying sniper enemy)
He was stealing the show from the bossfight, while generally being a pain to fight.
 Red shotgun rage ability duration buffed 
Just a biiit longer.
 Red Rocket launcher buffed
It is called "artillery" after all.
 Red Machine gun spread buffed
Better mid-range dps with headshots!


CONTENT

 Added 3 optional modifiers to level selection:
And for the Masochists...
[olist]
Modifier:  Game speed +33% faster
Modifier:  Random enemies spawn type
Modifier:  Double enemy spawn count
[/olist]
 Added secrets to Machinery level
 Added secrets to Clockwork level


QUALITY OF LIFE

 Minor changes to player movement
Changing direction is slightly faster now
 Graphics settings (Low/Ultra/etc) are now in-game
Previously only accessible in the Unity starting window.
 Shotgun crosshair now can be alternated
As some players prefer the small precision crosshair for hooks.
 noclip & hide hud keys now can be rebinded
You can use the B & V keys for other binds now!
 Enemies now can be spawned with J and H
Experiment with damage combos, or suggest better names for them!
 Added viewmodel field of view
No gun, big gun, noodle gun, have fun.
 Added more combo info in inventory
Functional but boring, for now!


Aaand that's about it for the update, see ya in the discord, and if you haven't:
JOIN US IN DISCORD
Just don't be a dick
